summary: The candidate correctly fixes and tests a real QSA speculative draft-extend metadata AttributeError by using the canonical num_tokens_per_req field, but it neither demonstrates semantic equivalence nor fails closed for the original Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 QSA + NEXTN decode-graph corruption. This is a partial fix, not a full resolution of the original issue.

tests.what_was_measured: The recorded base raises AttributeError because _speculative_max_row_length reads nonexistent draft_token_num.
Candidate focused regression: 5 passed and 37 deselected.
Full candidate QSA file: 41 passed and one NVIDIA SM121-only case skipped.
Three actual gfx950 GPU kernel/metadata comparisons against references passed.

tests.command: inline independent speculative-width and empty-host-length boundary cases
tests.what_was_measured: Widths 1 and 4, canonical-over-legacy precedence, no-speculation, and GPU fallback bounds matched independent expectations.

gpu_execution_evidence: Three QSA GPU reference tests and the empty-host-length fallback ran on one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950; PyTorch reports HIP 7.2.26015 and CUDA None.
remaining_counterexamples: The reported decode-graph profile still has no passing 1,024-token eager/graph semantic comparison and no fail-closed guard against punctuation-loop output.
The approximately 25K-token four-marker retrieval still has no passing eager/graph model-level comparison and no guard against marker loss or punctuation degeneration.
The exact 2x NVIDIA GB10 SM121 TP2/RoCEv2 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 configuration remains untested.
remaining_limitations: Only one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 GPU was available; CUDA and NVIDIA SM121 execution were unavailable.
No second GPU/node, TP2, or RoCEv2 environment was available.
The tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify the affected model architecture, semantic accuracy, CUDA graph implementation, or distributed topology and was not used as substitute proof.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
